verdict.rationale: Apify's JS client docs show a single `call()` to the first-party `apify/web-scraper` Actor, given start URLs and a `maxCrawlPages` crawl limit, which starts the Actor and waits for it to finish. The docs also show how to run an Actor and retrieve its results, so a multi-page crawl can be launched in one call. Retrieving the content is a separate dataset fetch, and whole-site crawl settings are not documented beyond a page cap. Missing for 10: documentation that crawling covers all pages of an entire site (link-following or scope configuration), a single request that returns page content directly, and independent or hands-on corroboration of full-site crawl results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can crawl an entire website and get content from all its pages with one request
